# force-push-overwrites-remote-commits

The publisher's recovery behavior force-pushes its snapshot to the remote branch, which overwrites any intervening commits (e.g. 'hand-edit.md' created by an external actor is removed). This presents a risk of data loss for changes made directly on the remote branch.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_publisher.py` — `tests.test_publisher.test_force_push_recovers_publisher_ownership`
